common.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

consent.heading: Before you start
consent.intro: Three separate choices, each in plain language. Only the first is required.
consent.essentialBody: Keeps your account working and protects it from abuse. Required to create an account.
consent.personalizeBody: Uses interests you tell us, next, to sort what you see. Off, and you still see everything — just not sorted for you.
consent.marketingBody: Messages about new campaigns or promotions, separate from the notifications about points you've actually earned.
consent.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

interests.heading: What are you into?
interests.intro: You turned on personalising which campaigns you see, so pick a few interests to sort what's shown. Change these any time on Me.

follow.heading: Follow a few channels
follow.intro: A private list that helps sort what you see — nobody else can see who you follow. Unfollow any time on Me.
follow.emptyBody: There aren't any channels in your region yet. You can follow one later from Me.
follow.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

done.heading: You're all set
done.body: Your account is ready. Start earning points by watching campaigns.
